svg.title: Ancient sites and a modern Taiwan study panel
svg.desc: Geographical map of Liangdao in the Matsu archipelago (2 ancient individuals), Suogang in Penghu (2), Hanben in Taiwan (45), and Gongguan on Green Island (1). Modern Ko et al. 2014 samples comprise 550 people from 12 reported groups in Taiwan; unverified collection locations are not plotted. Site points do not locate individual burials.
